STEP 1 - Vessel type: The food sits on a white square plate with a flat centre and a raised rim band. No curved inner wall is visible, so this is a flat plate (square).

STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Type cue: square plates are typically 20-30 cm. The plate fills much of the frame and looks like a standard dinner-sized square, so medium-large, about 25 cm.
b) Reference object: the broccoli florets are about 4 cm across. The cauliflower florets look about 4-5 cm. The plate spans roughly 6-7 florets across its visible width (about 26 cm), which fits 25-26 cm.
Final width: about 25 cm (square), area 625 cm².

STEP 3 - Food items:
- Cauliflower florets: about 5 florets, each roughly 4 x 4 x 3 cm. Footprint about 15% of plate (94 cm²), thickness about 3 cm (a mound of chunky pieces, average ~1.5 cm). Volume ≈ 94 × 1.5 ≈ 140 ml × 0.6 = 85 g.
- Roasted eggplant/zucchini pieces (dark brown chunks): footprint about 20% (125 cm²), average thickness about 1 cm (flat-ish layer, peak ~2 cm). Volume ≈ 125 ml × 0.6 = 75 g.
- Yellow squash and green zucchini slices: footprint about 8% (50 cm²), thickness about 0.8 cm. Volume ≈ 40 ml × 0.6 = 24 g.
- Broccoli florets: about 3 florets, footprint about 3% (19 cm²), thickness 2 cm. Volume ≈ 38 ml × 0.6 = 23 g.
- Red pepper piece and a few other bits: about 3 g total, negligible but included in the mix.
- Oil/sauce residue (glossy coating): smear about 0.3 cm over about 15% of plate (94 cm²) → 28 ml × 0.9 ≈ 25 g (olive oil-type, but treat as sauce at 1.0 g/ml; reduced for oil ~0.9).

Hidden food: the cauliflower and vegetables sit on a thin base; no rice or grain layer visible. No further hidden base added.

STEP 4 - Totals: 85 + 75 + 24 + 23 + 3 + 25 ≈ 235 g.

STEP 5 - kcal per 100 g (cooked, as served):
- Cauliflower, roasted: ~30 kcal/100 g
- Roasted eggplant/zucchini with oil: ~90 kcal/100 g (oil-absorbed)
- Yellow squash/zucchini, cooked: ~25 kcal/100 g
- Broccoli, cooked: ~35 kcal/100 g
- Red pepper: ~30 kcal/100 g
- Oil/sauce: ~850 kcal/100 g (the glossy residue is mostly oil)

Energy: cauliflower 85 g → 26 kcal; eggplant/zucchini 75 g → 68 kcal; squash 24 g → 6 kcal; broccoli 23 g → 8 kcal; pepper 3 g → 1 kcal; oil 25 g → 213 kcal (but the residue is thin, so likely closer to 10 g of oil, ~85 kcal). Using the smear as 10 g oil: total ≈ 26 + 68 + 6 + 8 + 1 + 85 ≈ 194 kcal over ~225 g, about 85 kcal/100 g average.

Summary: about 225-235 g of mixed roasted vegetables on a 25 cm square plate, roughly 190-200 kcal.
